memo:
THIS TURN: Play Island. Keep it untapped and cast Brainstorm ({U}) at the end of P3's turn, just before our turn 2. Look for a second red source (Command Tower, Steam Vents, Shivan Reef, Sulfur Falls, Scalding Tarn), Sol Ring or Arcane Signet. Put back two spare Islands or excess cards. Make no other plays.

TARGET: Turn 2: play Mountain and cast Harmonic Prodigy ({1}{R}). Turn 3: play Island and cast Vivi Ornitier ({1}{U}{R}). Turn 4: cast Guttersnipe, or protection plus a held counter. The end state is Vivi Ornitier with Harmonic Prodigy, which doubles her triggers because she is a Wizard and doubles Guttersnipe's because it is a Shaman. Missing pieces: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, Counterspell or Arcane Denial, and Archmage Emeritus or Rhystic Study.

WIN PATH: Build doubled Vivi pings and Guttersnipe burn, then finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot paid with Vivi's mana, around turns 8-10. P2 can combo on turns 5-7, so we must interact.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P1 > P3.
- P2 (Sephiroth): fastest drain combo. Bolt Sephiroth before it reaches four deaths in a turn.
- P1 (Sauron): gains value from every spell we cast. Clock turns 6-8. Counter Sauron if we can.
- P3 (Y'shtola): slow control. Leave alone for now.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Lightning Bolt is earmarked for Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER (3/3) or Pitiless Plunderer. Bolting any other creature while Sephiroth is out drains us 1. Bolt can't kill Y'shtola (2/4). Don't chump-block into P2's triggers. Once Sauron is out, cast fewer, bigger spells.

HOLD: Hold Brainstorm until the end of P3's turn. Hold Lightning Bolt for P2's engine. Never Bolt a face.

REPLAN IF:
- Brainstorm finds Sol Ring. Then on turn 2, cast Sol Ring with the Island, and cast Harmonic Prodigy with the Mountain plus Sol Ring. Vivi still comes on turn 3, because Sol Ring makes no blue.
- P2 casts Sephiroth with fodder. Then Bolt Sephiroth at once.
- An opponent shows an early combo piece.

THIS TURN: Play Steam Vents and let it enter tapped. Don't pay 2 life: we have no 1-drop. Pass. Turn 2: play Island and cast Coruscation Mage ({1}{R}, no offspring). Turn 3: play Command Tower (it taps for U or R) and cast Vivi Ornitier ({1}{U}{R}). Turn 4: with only 3 lands, choose one. Either hold Arcane Denial ({1}{U}) up to protect Vivi, or flash in Ophidian Eye ({2}{U}) on Vivi Ornitier at the end of an opponent's turn. Doing both needs 5 mana. Default to Denial while P1 or P2 has open mana, and cast Eye once a 4th land arrives.

TARGET: Vivi Ornitier plus Coruscation Mage, with Ophidian Eye on Vivi. Each noncreature spell then pings every opponent for 2 and draws 3. Next, add Guttersnipe or Veyran, Voice of Duality, and Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots on Vivi.

WIN PATH: Chain cheap spells to grow Vivi Ornitier, tap her for X, then cast Crackle with Power, Grapeshot or Jeska's Will. Late game: Niv-Mizzet, Parun loops. We aim to close around turn 8-9, against a turn 6-8 clock from P2 and P3.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P3 > P1.
- P2: sacrificed lands drain us for 2 each. Chaos Warp Hearthhull, the Worldseed or Zuran Orb.
- P3: cheap Giada, Font of Hope snowballs fliers. Answer Giada or Archangel of Thune early.
- P1: slower graveyard engine. Leave alone for now; Chaos Warp Teval's Judgment or Muldrotha only if they take over.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Chaos Warp: for Hearthhull, the Worldseed, Giada, Font of Hope or Archangel of Thune, whichever arrives first.
- Arcane Denial: for Living Death, Blasphemous Act or another wipe, removal aimed at Vivi Ornitier, or Akroma's Will.
- Don't feed P1's graveyard, and don't attack into deathtouch.

HOLD: Windfall. Cast it only when our hand is 2 or fewer cards, Vivi Ornitier and Ophidian Eye are on the battlefield, and opponents' hands are small. Keep Arcane Denial mana up once Vivi is out.

REPLAN IF: Giada or Hearthhull lands on turn 2 or 3; Chaos Warp it before casting Vivi. Also replan if an early wipe or Swords to Plowshares hits Vivi Ornitier, or we draw Sol Ring (then cast Vivi on turn 2).

THIS TURN: Play Steam Vents and pay 2 life so it enters untapped. Cast Preordain ({U}). Keep Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Izzet Signet, Talisman of Creativity, Fellwar Stone or a land on top; bottom expensive cards. Next turn: play Mountain, then cast a drawn two-mana rock, or Lightning Greaves ({2}) if no rock. Turn after: play Mountain and cast Vivi Ornitier ({1}{U}{R}). If there is spare mana, cast Sigil of Sleep ({U}) on Vivi first, then equip Lightning Greaves ({0}). Shroud blocks our own Aura, so the order matters.

TARGET: Vivi Ornitier wearing Sigil of Sleep and Lightning Greaves. Each Vivi ping damages every opponent, so each noncreature spell lets Sigil of Sleep bounce one creature per opponent. Add Guttersnipe, Veyran, Voice of Duality or Archmage Emeritus. Dig for Sol Ring and Rhystic Study.

WIN PATH: Grow Vivi with cheap spells, then pay for Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot with her mana. We aim to close around turns 8-10. P3 can kill around turns 6-8, so we must slow them.

THREAT ORDER: P3 > P2 > P1.
- P3: Skullclamp is down, and they make wide tokens and drain. Answer tokens and drainers.
- P2: flying Angels. Kill Giada, Font of Hope early.
- P1: slow graveyard deck. Leave them alone for now.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Exquisite Blood: counter it with An Offer You Can't Refuse. It can't counter creatures such as Vito or Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
- Vampire tokens: Fire Magic, Fire mode ({R}), at 3+ tokens. Skullclamp equips one creature at a time, so a wipe gives P3 two cards per clamped creature, usually one.
- Giada, Font of Hope (2/2): Fire Magic, Fira mode ({R}+{2}).

HOLD: An Offer You Can't Refuse for Exquisite Blood and for wipes or removal aimed at Vivi. Don't spend it on rocks.

REPLAN IF: Preordain finds Sol Ring (cast Vivi next turn). P3 fields 3+ X/1 creatures early. Anyone casts a turn-2 commander.

THIS TURN: This is our first land turn, and we have 0 mana. Play Command Tower, since it makes coloured mana without pain, cast nothing and pass. At the end of P4's turn (the turn just before ours), cast Brainstorm ({U} from Command Tower). Keep An Offer You Can't Refuse and Snap, and put back surplus cards, such as Storm-Kiln Artist if we are land-light. Never put back our only remaining land drops.

TARGET:
- Turn 2: play Shivan Reef, then cast Harmonic Prodigy (Shivan Reef {R}, 1 damage, plus Command Tower).
- Turn 3: play Cascade Bluffs, then cast Vivi Ornitier. Run Shivan Reef's {U/R} into Cascade Bluffs for 2, plus Command Tower, for 3 total.
- Turn 4: cast Storm-Kiln Artist if we have a 4th land, or cheap spells with {U} up for An Offer You Can't Refuse.
- Missing: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, Sol Ring or Arcane Signet, Counterspell or Arcane Denial, Guttersnipe, Veyran, Voice of Duality.

WIN PATH: Grow Vivi Ornitier with cantrips (Harmonic Prodigy doubles her trigger), then pay Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot with her mana, around turns 8-10. The opponents' clocks are turns 6-9, so interaction is essential.

THREAT ORDER: P3 > P1 > P4.
- P3: Sol Ring plus a land is 3 mana, so Sauron could arrive within 2 turns and punishes every spell we cast. Counter Sauron.
- P1: Pantlaza ramp into a hasty Dinosaur alpha strike. Blasphemous Act or Cyclonic Rift later.
- P4: slower graveyard value. Leave them alone for now.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Sauron: only Counterspell or Arcane Denial on the stack. Ward makes Pongify and Chaos Warp require sacrificing a legendary (Vivi Ornitier), so those are bad answers. Blasphemous Act also works.
- Rhythm of the Wild, Call of the Ring, The One Ring, Teval's Judgment: counter with An Offer You Can't Refuse (noncreature only; it cannot hit Sauron, Pantlaza or Wakening Sun's Avatar).

HOLD: An Offer You Can't Refuse for those noncreature spells or a wipe, never for early rocks or ramp (it gives them 2 Treasures). Snap to save Vivi Ornitier from removal; it untaps two lands.

REPLAN IF: Brainstorm finds Sol Ring (Vivi Ornitier on turn 2), P3 reaches 6 mana, or P1 lands Wrathful Raptors or Rhythm of the Wild.

THIS TURN: Play Training Center. It enters untapped now because we have three opponents. Tap it for {U} and cast Ponder. Keep lands and rocks (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Izzet Signet, Talisman of Creativity) on top, and shuffle if the top three have none. Hold Temple of Epiphany for a later drop. Next turn, play an untapped land if we drew one; otherwise play Temple of Epiphany (enters tapped, scry 1 for land/rock). If we have 2 open mana next turn, Abrade Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER (see THREATS). If we have 1, cast Opt.

TARGET: 3 lands, then Vivi Ornitier, then Fiery Inscription next to her. Dig targets: Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Lightning Greaves, Swiftfoot Boots, Guttersnipe, Veyran, Voice of Duality.

WIN PATH: Grow Vivi Ornitier with cheap spells while Fiery Inscription adds 2 per instant or sorcery. Later, cast Niv-Mizzet, Visionary with Vivi's mana to draw off every ping. Finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot. Our clock is about turns 8-10; P4 can combo around turns 5-7.

THREAT ORDER: P4 > P3 > P2. P4 has a turn-1 Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER and a live drain engine: kill it before fodder piles up. P3 goes wide with Vampires: watch for Vito and Skullclamp. P2 has no board: leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Abrade (3 damage) kills Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER, and its own death does not trigger its drain. Recasting costs P4 5 mana. Flame of Anor goes on Vito, Giada, Font of Hope or Pitiless Plunderer; with Vivi out, it gets two modes. While Sephiroth lives, kill no other creature (each death drains us), except Pitiless Plunderer, which must go.

HOLD: Fiery Inscription and Niv-Mizzet, Visionary until Vivi Ornitier is out. Hold Flame of Anor for a real threat.

REPLAN IF: We find Sol Ring or a signet (cast Vivi Ornitier early). P4 plays Ashnod's Altar (Abrade it, artifact mode) or Pitiless Plunderer. P3 lands Vito or Skullclamp.

THIS TURN: Play Island. Cast Coruscation Mage ({1}{R}) with Steam Vents and Island, without offspring. Pass with nothing up. Our next turn: play Command Tower, which taps for U or R because Vivi Ornitier is our commander (ignore the "no mana" label), and cast Vivi Ornitier ({1}{U}{R}). The turn after: play Temple of Epiphany (enters tapped, scry 1), leaving 3 untapped. Hold Arcane Denial ({1}{U}) through P1's and P2's turns while they have open mana. If nothing needs countering, flash Ophidian Eye ({2}{U}) onto Vivi Ornitier at the end of P3's turn. We can't afford both (5 mana).

TARGET: Vivi Ornitier plus Coruscation Mage, with Ophidian Eye on Vivi. Each noncreature spell then pings every opponent for 2 and draws 3, because Vivi's trigger damage triggers the Eye. Then add Guttersnipe or Veyran, Voice of Duality, and Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots on Vivi.

WIN PATH: Chain cheap spells, grow Vivi Ornitier, tap her for X, then cast Crackle with Power, Grapeshot or Jeska's Will. Late game, Niv-Mizzet, Parun loops. We close around game turn 9-10; P2 and P3 threaten around turn 7-8.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P3 > P1.
- P2: Exploration ramp into Hearthhull, the Worldseed land-sacrifice drains. Chaos Warp Hearthhull.
- P3: fliers snowball off Giada, Font of Hope. Chaos Warp Giada or Archangel of Thune. Segovian Angel is only a 1/1; ignore it.
- P1: slow graveyard engine. Leave alone for now.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Chaos Warp ({2}{R}, instant, any permanent): Hearthhull, the Worldseed, Giada, Font of Hope or Archangel of Thune, whichever lands first.
- Arcane Denial: a wipe (Blasphemous Act, Living Death), removal aimed at Vivi Ornitier, or Akroma's Will.
- Don't attack with Coruscation Mage into fliers or deathtouch; it's an engine, not a beater.

HOLD: Windfall until our hand is 2 or fewer cards, Vivi Ornitier and Ophidian Eye are on the battlefield, and opponents' hands are small. Keep Arcane Denial mana up once Vivi is out.

REPLAN IF: Giada or Hearthhull lands before our next turn (Chaos Warp it instead of casting Vivi). We draw Sol Ring (cast Vivi Ornitier a turn early). An early wipe, or Swords to Plowshares on Vivi.

THIS TURN: Play Sulfur Falls. It enters untapped because we control an Island. Tap Island and Sulfur Falls ({1}{R}) to cast Harmonic Prodigy. P1 and P3 have no untapped mana. P2's only open land is colourless High Market, so a counter is very unlikely. Attack P2 with Bird Token (2 flying). No opponent has a creature, and nobody can cast one big enough to punish us next turn. We keep no mana for opponents' turns.

TARGET: Next turn, play Mountain and cast Vivi Ornitier ({1}{U}{R}, all 3 lands) beside Harmonic Prodigy. Prodigy doubles her triggers because she is a Wizard. The turn after, play Island, cast Guttersnipe ({2}{R}) and keep Lightning Bolt ({R}) up, using all 4 lands. Still missing: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, Counterspell or Arcane Denial, Archmage Emeritus or Rhystic Study, and Sol Ring or Arcane Signet.

WIN PATH: Build doubled Vivi Ornitier pings and doubled Guttersnipe burn (Guttersnipe is a Shaman). Finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot paid with Vivi's mana, around turns 9-11. Every opponent has one land, so nobody is fast yet.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P1 > P3
- P2 (Sephiroth): fastest drain combo. Chip them with Bird Token and Bolt Sephiroth.
- P1 (Sauron): holds counters (Swan Song shown) and grows off our spells. Cast into their tapped mana.
- P3 (Y'shtola): slow control. Leave alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Lightning Bolt is earmarked for Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER (3/3) or Pitiless Plunderer. Killing any other creature while Sephiroth is out drains us, including our own Bird Token or Harmonic Prodigy dying. Bolt cannot kill Y'shtola (2/4) or Sauron (7/6, ward). Don't chump-block into P2's triggers.

HOLD: Hold Lightning Bolt for P2's engine; never Bolt a face. Guttersnipe waits until Vivi Ornitier is down. Keep Mountain and Island for our next two land drops.

REPLAN IF:
- P2 casts Sephiroth: Bolt it on sight, even though Bolt plus Vivi (4 mana) delays Vivi a turn.
- P1 leaves counter mana open when we want Vivi: we can't afford a Guttersnipe bait first (6 mana), so cast Vivi anyway. She costs only 2 more to recast.
- Harmonic Prodigy is removed: still cast Vivi next turn.

THIS TURN: Play Temple of Epiphany (it enters tapped). Scry 1 and keep a land or rock on top. Tap Training Center for {U} and cast Ponder. Keep lands and rocks on top (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Izzet Signet, Talisman of Creativity, Fellwar Stone). Shuffle if the top three hold no land or rock. Pass with nothing open; we have no 1-mana instant.

TARGET: 3 lands, then Vivi Ornitier. Then add Stormcatch Mentor: it is fodder against P4's edicts, a Wizard for two modes on Flame of Anor, and makes instants and sorceries cheaper. Then Fiery Inscription. Dig for Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Lightning Greaves, Swiftfoot Boots and Guttersnipe.

WIN PATH: Grow Vivi Ornitier with cheap spells while Fiery Inscription deals 2 per instant or sorcery. Cast Niv-Mizzet, Visionary off Vivi's mana to draw off every ping. Finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot. We are mana-light, so our clock is about turns 10-12. P4 and P3 threaten around turns 6-8.

THREAT ORDER: P4 > P3 > P2. P4 has Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER draining on every death, with edicts and wipes ahead; Abrade it when we have 2 spare mana. P3 is going wide with Vengeful Bloodwitch; watch for Vito and Skullclamp. P2 has only Sol Ring; leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Abrade (3 damage) kills Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER. Its own death does not drain. Recasting it costs P4 4 (3 plus 2 tax, minus 1 from Jet Medallion). Flame of Anor goes on Vito, Pitiless Plunderer, Giada, Font of Hope or a lord. Use Abrade's artifact mode on Ashnod's Altar or Skullclamp. While Sephiroth lives, don't kill other creatures: each death drains us. Killing P3's creatures also triggers Vengeful Bloodwitch.

HOLD: Windfall, because it refills opponents. Hold Fiery Inscription and Niv-Mizzet, Visionary until Vivi Ornitier is out. Next turn with 3 mana, cast Vivi Ornitier. With only 2, Abrade Sephiroth or cast Stormcatch Mentor.

REPLAN IF: We draw Sol Ring or a signet (cast Vivi Ornitier sooner). P4 lands Ashnod's Altar, Pitiless Plunderer or Grave Pact. P3 lands Vito or Skullclamp. P2 casts Giada, Font of Hope.

THIS TURN: Play Shivan Reef. Cast Harmonic Prodigy for {1}{R}: take {R} from Command Tower and {C} from Shivan Reef, so the Reef deals no damage. That uses both sources, so we pass with nothing up. An Offer You Can't Refuse would find nothing worth countering this round anyway, and it cannot hit Sauron (a creature).

TARGET:
- Next turn: play Cascade Bluffs and cast Vivi Ornitier for {1}{U}{R}. Command Tower's {U} pays Cascade Bluffs, which makes {U}{R}; Shivan Reef adds {C}.
- The turn after: cheap spells (Preordain) to grow Vivi Ornitier, since Harmonic Prodigy doubles her triggers. Keep {U} up for An Offer You Can't Refuse.
- Later: Birgi, God of Storytelling, then Niv-Mizzet, Parun at 6 mana.
- Missing: Blasphemous Act, Cyclonic Rift, Counterspell or Arcane Denial, Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, Sol Ring or Arcane Signet, a 4th land.

WIN PATH: Grow Vivi Ornitier with doubled triggers and ping the table. Close with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot, paid from Vivi's mana, around turns 9-11. Niv-Mizzet, Parun is the backup engine. Opponents' clocks are turns 6-9, so we must answer Sauron.

THREAT ORDER: P3 > P1 > P4.
- P3: Sol Ring, Commander's Sphere, 2 lands and a land drop make 6 mana, so Sauron can land on P3's turn this round. He punishes every spell we cast. Answer Sauron.
- P1: ramps toward Pantlaza and a Dinosaur alpha strike. Watch for Rhythm of the Wild and Wrathful Raptors.
- P4: slow graveyard engine. Leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Sauron: Blasphemous Act or overloaded Cyclonic Rift. Neither targets, so ward doesn't apply. Counterspell or Arcane Denial also work while he is on the stack. Snap and Chaos Warp target him, which triggers ward (we must sacrifice a legendary), so avoid them.
- Rhythm of the Wild, Call of the Ring, The One Ring, Teval's Judgment: counter with An Offer You Can't Refuse.
- Once Sauron is out, cast fewer, bigger spells.

HOLD: An Offer You Can't Refuse for those noncreature threats, never for rocks or ramp. Snap to save Vivi Ornitier or Harmonic Prodigy from removal.

REPLAN IF: Sauron resolves (dig for Blasphemous Act), P1 casts Rhythm of the Wild or Wrathful Raptors, or we draw Sol Ring.

THIS TURN: Play Mountain and keep Scalding Tarn and the second Mountain for later land drops. Cast Lightning Greaves ({2}: Steam Vents plus Mountain). Tapping out is acceptable because P3 has only 3 mana, too little for Exquisite Blood, and nothing else on the table needs An Offer You Can't Refuse yet. Next turn: play Scalding Tarn and fetch an Island (pay 1 life), or play Mountain. Cast Vivi Ornitier ({1}{U}{R}) and equip Lightning Greaves to her at once ({0}).

TARGET: Vivi Ornitier in Lightning Greaves, plus Guttersnipe, Veyran, Voice of Duality or Archmage Emeritus. Sigil of Sleep can go on Vivi only while she isn't shrouded, so do it when a second creature can hold Greaves: move Greaves to that creature, cast Sigil of Sleep on Vivi, then equip Greaves back to Vivi. Each Vivi ping then bounces a creature. Dig for Sol Ring, Rhystic Study, Chaos Warp and Pongify.

WIN PATH: Vivi pings plus Guttersnipe, then Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot paid with Vivi's mana. We aim for turns 9-11. P2's Serra Ascendant hits for 6 a turn with lifelink now, and P3 can close around turns 7-9.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P3 > P1.
- P2: Serra Ascendant is a 6/6 lifelink flier and keeps P2 above 30. Remove it with a spot answer; pinging P2 below 30 is not realistic soon.
- P3: Skullclamp, tokens and a possible drain combo. Answer the drainers.
- P1: slow graveyard deck. Leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Serra Ascendant: Chaos Warp or Pongify when drawn. Fire Magic can't kill it; Firaga deals only 3.
- Exquisite Blood and wipes aimed at our board: An Offer You Can't Refuse.
- 3+ Vampire tokens: Fire Magic, Fire mode ({R}).
- Giada, Font of Hope (2/2): Fire Magic, Fira mode ({R}+{2}).
- Don't make P3 draw off Skullclamp with small, pointless kills.

HOLD: An Offer You Can't Refuse, from next turn on, for Exquisite Blood or a wipe once Vivi is out. Blasphemous Act for a wide board only. It costs 9 minus 1 per creature, and it also kills Vivi.

REPLAN IF: We draw Sol Ring (next turn, cast Vivi and hold An Offer You Can't Refuse). P2 casts Giada or Archangel of Thune. P3 lands Vito or Exquisite Blood.

THIS TURN: Play Mountain. Tap Island, Sulfur Falls and Mountain ({1}{U}{R}) to cast Vivi Ornitier; there is no commander tax on this first cast. She is safe from counters: P1 and P3 are tapped out, and P2 has only High Market's {C} (Cabal Coffers needs {2} and Swamps). Attack P2 with Bird Token and Harmonic Prodigy. No opponent has a creature, so there is no crack-back. No mana is left open.

TARGET: Next turn, play Island (4 lands). Cast Guttersnipe ({2}{R}) and keep one red source open for Lightning Bolt. Harmonic Prodigy doubles the Vivi Ornitier and Guttersnipe triggers. Still missing: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, Counterspell or Arcane Denial, Rhystic Study or Archmage Emeritus, and Sol Ring or Arcane Signet.

WIN PATH: Each noncreature spell gives Vivi Ornitier 2 counters and pings each opponent for 2. With Guttersnipe out, each instant or sorcery adds 4 more. Finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot paid with Vivi's mana, about 4-5 turns out. That beats P2's combo if Sephiroth is answered.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P1 > P3
- P2 (Sephiroth): 7 cards, fastest drain combo. Attack them and Bolt Sephiroth.
- P1 (Sauron): ramps, holds counters and grows off our spells. Cast into their tapped mana.
- P3 (Y'shtola): slow control. Leave alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Lightning Bolt is earmarked for Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Pitiless Plunderer, at instant speed. Cyclonic Rift ({1}{U}) is for The One Ring or Call of the Ring. Never target Sauron: his ward would cost us Vivi. Don't chump-block into Sephiroth's triggers.

HOLD: Hold Lightning Bolt for P2's engine, never a face. Keep an Island for next turn's land drop. Hold Cyclonic Rift.

REPLAN IF:
- Vivi Ornitier is countered or removed: the recast costs 5 and we have only 4 lands next turn. Cast Guttersnipe plus hold Bolt next turn, and recast Vivi the turn after.
- P2 casts Sephiroth: Bolt it at the first window where we have red open.
- Harmonic Prodigy dies: still cast Guttersnipe next turn.

THIS TURN: Play Command Tower. It taps for U or R because Vivi Ornitier is our commander, so ignore the "no mana" label. Cast Vivi Ornitier ({1}{U}{R}, tax 0) with Steam Vents, Island and Command Tower, which taps us out. Attack P1 with Coruscation Mage for 2: it isn't summoning sick, P1 has no creatures, and the crack-back (Augur of Autumn 2, Segovian Angel 1) is trivial. Never attack into P2's Augur of Autumn (2/3) or P3's fliers. Pass.

TARGET: Next turn, play Temple of Epiphany (enters tapped, scry 1), leaving 3 untapped lands. Hold Arcane Denial ({1}{U}) through P1's and P2's turns. If it's unused, flash Ophidian Eye ({2}{U}) onto Vivi Ornitier at the end of P3's turn; we can't afford both. The turn after, cast Resonating Lute ({2}{U}{R}); its lands then give 2 mana each for instant and sorcery chains. Missing pieces: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, then Guttersnipe or Veyran, Voice of Duality.

WIN PATH: Vivi Ornitier with Coruscation Mage pings each opponent for 2 per noncreature spell. With Ophidian Eye on Vivi, each spell also draws 3. Grow Vivi with cheap spells, tap her for X, then finish with Crackle with Power, Grapeshot or Jeska's Will. Our clock is roughly 4 turns; P2 and P3 are about 3 turns from real pressure.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P3 > P1.
- P2: Exploration and Augur of Autumn are ramping into Hearthhull, the Worldseed drains. Chaos Warp Hearthhull.
- P3: Giada, Font of Hope angel snowball. Chaos Warp Giada or Archangel of Thune.
- P1: slow graveyard deck on 2 lands. It is our only safe attack target; otherwise leave it alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Chaos Warp ({2}{R}, instant): Hearthhull, the Worldseed, then Giada, Font of Hope, then Archangel of Thune.
- Arcane Denial: removal aimed at Vivi Ornitier, Blasphemous Act, Living Death, or Akroma's Will.

HOLD: Windfall, because P1 holds 7 cards and it would refill them. Cast it only when opponents' hands are small and ours is 2 or fewer. Keep Arcane Denial mana up on opponents' turns once Vivi Ornitier is out.

REPLAN IF: Hearthhull or Giada lands (Chaos Warp it instead of casting Ophidian Eye). Vivi Ornitier is removed. A wipe resolves. We draw Sol Ring or Lightning Greaves (cast it before Ophidian Eye).

THIS TURN: Play Mountain. Tap all 3 lands and cast Vivi Ornitier ({1}{U}{R}, no tax yet). If we draw Sol Ring, cast it first off one land, then cast Vivi Ornitier using {C} plus {U} and {R} from lands. The leftover mana is only {C}, which casts nothing in hand, so don't plan a cantrip with it. Don't cast Windfall. Pass. Don't block with Vivi Ornitier: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's 3 power kills her and drains us. We are at 40, so take the hits.

TARGET: Next turn, cast Stormcatch Mentor ({U}{R}). Then cast Abrade on Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER; it costs {R} with Mentor out, and it gives Vivi +1 and pings. Then activate Vivi for 1. Cast Flame of Anor ({U}{R} with Mentor) only if we drew a 4th land. Fiery Inscription gets no discount and waits. Build Vivi, Stormcatch Mentor, Fiery Inscription, then Niv-Mizzet, Visionary.
